findings.finding: Frozen runner cannot construct any book: eligibility is 0 names at 100% of decisions for all six arms (independent re-run; root cause = each name's own date array indexed at the global union-calendar index, dates[i] != d for 409/409 files at measured decision 2018-07-03; ADV63 window likewise index-corrupted). Scored execution as-frozen would emit vacuous all-zero cells and consume the entire 6/6 budget. Implementation does not implement the frozen universe floor / book construction.

Committed q_dummy_dryrun_evidence.json DRY_RUN_PASS is structurally vacuous: schedule floors count decisions over always-empty books; per-decision eligible/populated/legs distributions are omitted from the evidence, hiding the F-A7-1 failure from the freeze record.
Unit-USD population filter declared in both selected proposals is not implemented (load_panel drops u; CAD rows exist in the panel for all 9 cited fields - measured 23-192 rows per field).
a4_h2 eff-date-agreement filter (numerator/denominator selected eff dates within 400 days of each other, else unpopulated) not implemented in ratio_level signal construction.
Stress rerun (2x band cost, 20/30/50 bps) has no code path: run_arm exposes no stress parameter; the frozen '2 (base + stress)' scoring cells per arm are not executable as frozen.

Fold-boundary forced-flat under-implemented: held/prev_w are not reset at fold boundaries, so rank-hysteresis state and weight deltas carry across folds and boundary close/reopen costs are under-charged (anti-conservative for booked PnL).
a4_h1 330-400d eff-gap fiscal-type filter is applied only to the AR leg's eff dates; INV and AP leg vintages are unchecked against the declared filter.
Cost band fallback BAND_BPS.get(b, 10.0) silently assigns band-A (10 bps) cost to any changed name absent from the current decision's eligibility map (e.g. close legs of dropped names).
